text: I've had this cough going on for about two months now. It started dry, but recently it's become much worse and I'm coughing up white phlegm, though I haven't seen any blood. text: That level of exertion causing shortness of breath is concerning for heart failure. Do you ever wake up at night gasping for air or needing to prop yourself up with extra pillows to breathe? REQUEST TEST: Physical_Exam_Focus (Lung_Crackles, JVP, S3_Gallop, Peripheral_Edema)
